Description: Images showing visible eggshell crack lines, shell fractures, broken shell regions, or crack-like discontinuities were labelled as cracked.
Images without visible shell cracks were labelled as non-cracked, including eggs with dirt marks, stains, colour variation, or natural shell irregularities.
Images obtained from datasets were manually re-annotated into the two target classes.
When reviewers disagreed, the final class label was assigned by majority voting.
Images with excessive blur, unclear crack visibility, heavy obstruction, duplicate content, or uncertain class membership were excluded or rechecked before inclusion.
Duplicate, near-duplicate, and highly similar images were prevented from appearing in both training and independent test subsets.
Camera model, sensor settings, lens parameters, egg storage age, and exact illumination details were not consistently available for public-source images.
